newsitem.title: USA: Chase Manhattan Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Chase Manhattan Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Per-share results for the current quarter are reported on an operating basis. Fourth-quarter 1996 net income, after a restructuring charge of $0.15 per share on a primary basis, or $0.14 on a fully diluted basis, is $1.74 per share on both primary and fully diluted basis, compared with $1.73 on both a primary and fully diluted basis for the year-ago quarter.

For the full year, per-share income after charges, was $5.02 compared with $6.20 a year ago on a primary basis. On a fully diluted basis, net income per share for the full year was $4.94 compared with $6.04.

Net income applicable to common stock was $781.0 million for the fourth quarter compared with $773.0 million a year ago. For the 12 months, net income applicable to common stock was $2.24 billion for the year compared with $2.73 billion.
Chase Manhattan's fourth-quarter trading revenues rose to $457 million from $399 million a year earlier.
